descriptionLoadedFunctionalMode: Mode for highlighting loaded elements (with multiple styles)
descriptionConstantViewMode: Mode for displaying with constant element highlights
descriptionFadeViewMode: Mode for displaying with fading brightness of highlighted elements
descriptionIntervalReduceOpacity: Interval for reducing the opacity of highlighted elements
descriptionPercentReduceOpacity: Percentage of opacity reduction for highlighted elements
descriptionMaxQuantityLayers: Maximum number layer of child elements in a component. Needed for filtering elements during highlighting. The value should be higher than the «Minimum Layer» field. Optional value.
descriptionMinQuantityLayers: Minimum number layer of child elements in a component. Needed for filtering elements during highlighting. Optional value.
descriptionColorHighlight: Color of the highlight for found elements
